query:
SELECT sc.chatter_login
               FROM twitch_session_chatters sc
               JOIN twitch_live_state ls ON ls.active_session_id = sc.session_id
              WHERE LOWER(ls.streamer_login) = LOWER($1)
                AND ls.is_live = 1
                AND TRIM(COALESCE(sc.chatter_login, '')) <> ''
